notes:
Summary: Enterprise code-assistant POC for regulated trading desk + internal platform teams. Key ask: private/VPC deployment or on-prem edge to keep code+symbols within corp network. Must support SSO (SAML/SCIM), long-term audit logs, and configurable retention. Model/version pinning mandatory for auditability; want ability to pin to major.minor and rollback.

Customer quotes / call fragments: "We cannot have keys or session tokens leaving our VPC for sensitive repos." / "Need deterministic model pinning and binary/weights provenance for audits."

Technical requirements (concise):
- Workload: IDE copilot (VS Code, JetBrains), batch code-completion, code review summarization, reranking for code search.
- Latency: streaming completions 95p <50ms token latency target for interactive completions; cold start POC target <200ms.
- Throughput: ~200 concurrent devs during peak, ~2000 completions/minute estimated.
- Model needs: open-models preferred; allow pinning to exact model hash; ability to fall back to smaller quantized model when capacity constrained.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency, per-user audit trails with export to their SIEM (Splunk).
- Retention: retention controls per data-class; 7 years for audit artifacts, 90 days for prompt/response ephemeral logs unless flagged.

Procurement notes: Pricing sensitivity but willing to commit for dedicated capacity if SLAs + private control plane + HSM/KMS integration are clear. Estimated ARR band added above. Legal wants DPA + addendum for data residency. SE tasks: provide HSM integration pattern, example KMS envelopes, and certified SOC2/ISO docs.

POC success criteria (customer agreed):
- SAML SSO working end-to-end for 250 users
- Streaming completions meet 95p latency target in their VPC deployment
- Audit logs emitted in required format and ingested into customer's SIEM
- Model pinning test: deploy pinned model, simulate rollback of minor release

Notes style: shorthand and bullets captured from calls; some repetition intentional (security emphasis).
additional_comments: Prefer Redwood private with on-prem edge for secret handling. Interested in Optimize suggestions for batching to reduce cost while holding latency SLOs. Wants playbook for canary rollouts and automatic fallback to pinned older model version when new release shows regressions.
